description: Turn an articulated molecular key to maintain contact inside a stepwise deforming 3D pocket. All connected tips must stay seated as the pocket advances after committed torsion actions.
name: Pocket Locksmith V3 · Difficulty 1 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Start the binding trial, then keep the colored key atoms inside their matching moving sockets. Turning a bond moves every downstream atom. Earn 19.68 seconds of simultaneous contact before the 24-second deadline; prolonged contact loss ends the attempt. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, or page-state inspection; the terminal, shell, Python, address bar, URL or query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs. Before START BINDING, inspect the unmarked drive linkages with reversible test turns: each drive operates one bond, possibly in reverse. A moving joint reveals its connection and direction; that label remains visible. Return to neutral before starting. You may also orbit the views. Test turns remain available during the live trial without pausing it. Temporary contact loss remains recoverable within the displayed allowance. Dissociation, failure to earn the contact quota, or a rejected ABANDON / SUBMIT ends the episode; later resets or submissions cannot pass.
